turns.content: For ten flips with four heads and six tails, calculate the probability of one particular admissible sequence instead of counting all sequences.
Express the number of sequences using stars and bars.
Rewrite the expression obtained above in factorial form, preserving the treatment of outcomes established in the preceding steps.
Evaluate the expression for the stated composition.
Check the result through an equivalent complementary reformulation of the same outcome representation.
Report the number of ordered sequences.
